topics.topic: Ownership of writing/copying durable StoredValue or fixture/value data during capture
questions: Who is the writing owner of StoredValue records: one module, or multiple producer modules?
Does `runs` only authorize capture and pass references, or does it materially copy bytes/fixtures (which are function-corpus data owned by `functions`)?

topics.topic: Single-module ownership and enforcement of NodeExecution writes across all statuses/paths
questions: Is M23 owned by one module, or intentionally split between `effects` and `runs` by status/path?
Which module is the single owner of NodeExecution writes, and how is that ownership enforced for all statuses?

topics.topic: Which module owns filtered/list selection semantics (repair-view membership rules and pagination token validity)
questions: Which module owns the computed selection logic for the repair view (latest function-node NodeExecutions pinned to any contract version of the slot, reverse store order, capped): `surface`, `runs`, `functions`, or `store`?
How does `store.page_records` know list membership for filtered/domain lists (runs of one flow, traces of one slot, etc.) without owning those list semantics?

topics.topic: Data model decision for ManifestOperation send-time fields (required_headers and instance class)
questions: Are `required_headers` and instance `class` part of ManifestOperation data, a separate instance object, or fetched independently at send time?

topics.topic: Module responsible for validating manifest effect_class against allowed values during binding operations
questions: Which module validates that a manifest `effect_class` is one of the five allowed values when proposing/accepting a binding: `bindings` (owner of A08) or another module?

topics.topic: Run output state model: persisted in Run records vs derived at read time from trace/element records
questions: Is run output state persisted in Run records, or always derived from trace/element records at read time?

topics.topic: Whether surface may derive decision-critical facts from raw records or must use owning-module capabilities
questions: Is `surface` allowed to derive decision-relevant facts (masking class) from raw records, or must it obtain a computed class via owning-module capabilities?
